# AI-Based Smart Video Learning Tool - MERN Stack Project

## Project Overview
Production-ready AI-powered educational platform that transforms YouTube videos into structured learning experiences with summaries, key points, and interactive quizzes.

## Tech Stack
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB (Mongoose)
- **Frontend**: React.js with modern UI/UX
- **AI Integration**: OpenAI GPT-4, YouTube transcript extraction
- **Theme**: Light/Dark mode support with persistent preferences
- **Authentication**: JWT-based secure authentication
- **State Management**: React Context API

## Architecture
- MVC pattern for backend with service layer
- Component-based React frontend with context providers
- REST API architecture with proper error handling
- MongoDB for data persistence with proper indexing
- Responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)

## Features Implemented
### Backend
- User registration & login with JWT
- YouTube transcript extraction & cleaning
- AI-powered content generation (summaries, key points, quizzes)
- Video processing & storage
- Quiz management with attempt tracking
- User dashboard statistics
- Learning progress analytics
- Input validation & error handling

### Frontend
- Modern, professional UI/UX
- Light/Dark theme with smooth transitions
- Responsive design (mobile-first)
- Dashboard with statistics
- Video input & processing
- Summary & key points display
- Interactive quiz component
- Learning history management
- Toast notifications
- Loading states & error handling

## Next Steps for Deployment
1. Set up MongoDB database (local or MongoDB Atlas)
2. Configure environment variables (.env files)
3. Install dependencies (npm install)
4. Start backend server (npm run dev)
5. Start frontend server (npm start)
6. Test complete user flow
7. Deploy to production (Heroku/Vercel)
